notes: The verse-opening *and* is a rule 88 juncture on the finite verb ᾐτήσατο it introduces, the participle προσελθών of 9:1 having been rendered finitely there; it is not added under rule 86, the licensing token being the verb in this verse.
ὄντας keeps the supplied relativizer and copula, the participle being expressed (rule 31).
τε … καί → *whether … or*, each particle keeping its own English word.
